source: User B18/B19 resistance readings and annotated measured J3-to-U7 connections.

physical_pad_mapping.U7.2: Middle empty pad to middle J3.2 / blue wire / H_PIR_RAW.
physical_pad_mapping.U7.3: Round outer empty pad: right in user front photo; bottom in IMG_2441. Connects to J3.1 / red wire / H_PIR_VDD.

qualifications: Connector continuity is reported by the user; no numerical ohms were supplied for those three pairs.
The square pad is local pin1 on each footprint, but lies at opposite ends: U7.1 is not J3.1.
U7 remains an empty three-hole option, not a newly identified or fitted IC.
400 kohm establishes no direct copper join and is not an added resistor value. TP16 onward routing remains unresolved.
Existing branches on the three J3 nets retain their individual evidence qualifications.
